name: Gemini CLI
notes: Gemini CLI gained subagents: Markdown + YAML frontmatter in .gemini/agents/ (user level ~/.gemini/agents/), body = system prompt. Roles use that rather than the TOML custom commands in .gemini/commands/, which remain TOML but are a worse fit — a command runs in the current context, a subagent gets its own. `tools` is omitted deliberately: Gemini's tool names (read_file, run_shell_command, …) are not the Claude vocabulary, and naming them wrongly would strip the role's tools.
